_comment: Baselines for the AIR erasure gate. total_unproven_retain = bucket-C ceiling (C must never grow). provable_fixtures_must_be_clean = programs that must carry zero axis calls and nothing beyond the substrate floor. substrate_floor = the named Sync/Abort symbols EVERY emitted program carries regardless of axis use; the gate pins the control fixture (00_pure_value) to exactly this set, so floor growth is RED until a human commits a new baseline with attribution. retained_runtime_attribution = fixtures with declared retain facts or physical residue beyond the substrate floor; A/B/C counts and floor-excess physical counts are pinned so retained runtime cost cannot drift without an attributed baseline update. expected_drifts = fixtures whose declared-vs-measured mismatch is a KNOWN, documented modeling gap; a drift OUTSIDE this list is a regression to investigate.

substrate_floor.attribution: R6 wall-time budget watchdog (pgy_budget_wall_watchdog, src/runtime/pgy_runtime_budget.h): pthread_create+pthread_detach spawn the watchdog thread, abort is the wall-budget fail-close. Bucket-B substrate (designed fail-closed enforcement, always-on), landed with task #41; floor moved 0->(Sync 2, Abort 1) at the 2026-07-04 dashboard refresh.

01_slot_provable_with.reason: The straight-line with-slot boundary is semantically retained as an execution boundary, but MIR proves and erases the physical slot machinery. Attribution pins the declared retain even when no runtime residue survives beyond the substrate floor.

03_secure_slot.reason: The secure-slot claim, write, and release carry three policy-retain facts, while statically traceable token provenance lets the C optimizer erase their physical checks beyond the watchdog substrate floor.

04_channel_parallel.reason: Inherent concurrency and channel synchronization. AIR declares both boundary retain causes and the program-wide concurrency summary; the measured pthread residue is the primitive that remains after axis erasure and lane scheduling. pthread_cond_timedwait is the bounded wait quantum used to retire cancelled any-join losers (6d29fef9). pthread_once is the one-time default PgyRuntimeContext initializer reached by lane context capture (b4846491); it prevents racy or partially initialized process-default authority and is not an undeclared semantic fallback.

05_zone_intent.reason: Runtime-visible zone/intent coordination. AIR declares the retained coordination facts, and the measured sync residue is pinned as floor-excess runtime cost.

06_lifecycle_branch.reason: Unproven lifecycle guard. The current nm-based symbol oracle is floor-level for abort, so the semantic retain is pinned even when no extra abort symbol appears beyond the watchdog floor.

08_secure_slot_method.reason: SecureSlot/DeviceSlot capability checks declared from MIR resource-op type-layout facts. The policy retain is pinned even when the measured symbol oracle has no floor-excess residue.
